label: Happy path
description: Clean text PDF, explicit PO, amounts match exactly.

label: Edge: tax embedded + name variant
description: Different layout. Tax is embedded in one total (no tax line), PO written as '5002', vendor name differs from master ('Pvt Ltd' vs 'Private Limited'), net is 1.2% over PO, inside tolerance.

label: Edge: split PO (1 of 2)
description: Vendor bills half of PO-5003. Approved as partial billing; PO balance tracked.

label: Edge: split PO (2 of 2)
description: Second half of PO-5003. Cumulative billing now equals the PO, so it is fully billed. Same amount as invoice 1 but different date, so not flagged as a duplicate.

label: Edge: over PO by 20%
description: Extra 'deep-clean' line pushes net to 9,840 against an 8,200 PO. Rejected with a vendor email asking for a credit note or change order.

label: Edge: no PO reference
description: Bundled single line, no PO number anywhere. The process infers PO-5007 from vendor + amount + description but never auto-approves an inferred match.

label: Edge: missing critical info
description: No invoice number, no date, no totals, only line items. Put on hold and a precise request is drafted to the vendor.

label: Edge: scanned image (OCR)
description: Image-only PDF with noise and skew, no text layer. OCR path, with confidence shown.

label: Edge: high-value approval
description: Everything matches PO-5005 but the 65,625 total is above the 50,000 threshold, so it is routed to the finance controller.

label: Edge: unknown vendor + stolen PO
description: Vendor not in the master, citing another vendor's PO. Rejected and escalated internally, not to the sender.

label: Edge: duplicate (payment reminder)
description: Vendor re-sends invoice 01 as a 'payment reminder'. Different file bytes, same invoice number, caught as a duplicate. Run after sample 01.
